extends.description: Org baseline URL. Fetched, then this scope merges on top. Pinned by sha256 in lockfile (Gap 4).

strict_capabilities.description: If true, a capability mismatch hard-blocks install instead of warning (Gap 5).

providers.description: Provider connection blocks. User/local scope only — NEVER in committed project config. API keys are ${ENV} refs only.

api_key.description: Env-var reference ${VAR} or the literal 'ollama' sentinel. Literal secrets are a lint error.

version.description: semver range or workspace:* for monorepo-local.

source.description: Optional explicit source override (npm:, file://, https://).

config.description: Per-extension config keyed by extension id. Deep-merged across scopes.

enabled.description: Per-extension enable/disable override keyed by id. Narrowest scope wins.

private.description: If true, this scope's extensions are excluded from registry publication and global dedup.
